item.title: About
item.description:
Designer’s Ledger is a practical guide to the business side of freelance design: managing client projects, communicating clearly, and getting paid on time.

The design part of freelancing gets plenty of coverage. The admin part — proposals, contracts, invoices, follow-ups, file chaos — mostly gets learned the hard way. This site collects those lessons into playbooks you can use the same day.

How the articles are made

Articles here are built from research: what freelance designers actually say in forums and interviews, and what real users report in reviews of the tools freelancers rely on. When an article quotes someone, it says where the quote comes from. When it discusses a tool, it focuses on what users praise and complain about — and on the questions you should ask before choosing — rather than repeating vendor marketing claims.

item.title: Affiliate Disclosure
item.description:
Designer’s Ledger is reader-supported. Some links on this site are affiliate links. If you click one of those links and buy a product or subscribe to a service, we may earn a commission from the seller — at no additional cost to you.

This disclosure is provided in accordance with the U.S. Federal Trade Commission’s guidelines on endorsements and testimonials (16 CFR Part 255).

What this means in practice

  • Articles are written from research — including real user reviews, both positive and negative — before affiliate relationships are considered.
  • We only link to products and services that are relevant to the article’s topic.
  • A commission never buys a recommendation. Where users report problems with a tool, we say so, including for tools we link to.
  • Individual articles that contain affiliate links carry a short disclosure note near the top of the page.

If you have questions about this policy, you can reach us through the contact information on the About page.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Last updated: November 2026

What we collect

  • Analytics. This site uses Google Analytics to understand which articles are read and how visitors arrive. Analytics data is aggregated and does not identify you personally.
  • Email subscriptions. If you subscribe to our email list or download a free resource, we collect the email address you provide, so we can send what you asked for. Every email includes an unsubscribe link.
  • Affiliate links. When you click an affiliate link, the seller’s site may use cookies to attribute the visit. Those cookies are set by the seller, under the seller’s own privacy policy.

What we do not do

  • We do not sell your personal information.
  • We do not collect payment information. Purchases happen on the seller’s site, not here.

Cookies

This site itself sets no tracking cookies of its own. Third-party services we use (analytics, email, and affiliate partners) may set cookies as described above. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings at any time.
